## Checklist

- [ ] My deck is at `people/<First_Last>/<deck-name>.qmd` (or `lab/<name>/` for a lab deck)
- [ ] The front matter has `title`, `author`, `date`, `description`, `image` and `event_type`
- [ ] `quarto render` runs without errors on my machine (or the PR check below is green)
- [ ] All images and media are inside my folder; no build output (`*.html`, `*_files/`) is committed
- [ ] No unpublished data, private links or confidential material
- [ ] Large media is compressed (aim for under 25 MB total)
